examples.item: The candidate preserves the central proposition and the scare-to-self-recognition-to-product-to-trust progression.
It rejects causal proof for the stroke framing, clinical proof for AI advice, proof of complete privacy, and a definite paid-ad status.
All 30 core units have resolvable transcript, shot, targeted-frame, OCR, or registered-source evidence.
The diagnostic UI wording, reference/seek-care limits, commercial-control unknown, and OCR-only recovery statement retain exact evidence and scope.
The non-speech carrier now has a registered full-stream PCM source and bounded semantic observations over 22 gap-free timeline windows plus nine transition windows.
All 31 positive knowledge-unit statements have direct evidence and preserve material limits.
Music-like continuity and transition-accent roles are presented as possibilities from mixed-track model observations, not literal sound identities or editorial intent.
Clinical suitability, live continuity, longitudinal benefit, corporate provenance, privacy guarantees, and commercial control remain unproven.
Every knowledge unit keeps its checked direct evidence inside its declared time range.
KU-25 uses only later UI/reference evidence, KU-28 uses only closing evidence, and KU-36 uses only 40.0-56.667 second diagnostic/reference evidence.
KU-33 and SRC-AUDIO-NON-SPEECH are bounded to the independently re-decoded 0-105.629 second stream.

processDependencyCompleteness.rationale: All 13 audited relation groups are represented with direct evidence at their semantic endpoints: news material to presenter identification, illustrations to target-user referent, visible product identity to narrated provenance, health fields to privacy relevance, fatigue answer to follow-up sequence, coffee narration to UI conditions, body inputs to plan output, goal states to unproven persistence, reminder language to non-urging narration, UI progress/edit order to non-continuous workflow, diagnostic framing to reference/seek-care limits, opening fear to closing trust promise, and branded product-experience framing to unknown payment/control.

examples.item: The candidate preserves unknowns for case authenticity/causation, clinical validation, demo continuity, data identity, professional standards, privacy controls, commercial relationships, outcomes, access conditions, presenter identity, and source authorization.
Audio title, creator, provenance, license, source separation, literal transient labels, foreground/background placement, and editorial intent remain unknown.
The candidate does not separately state whether the opening narration accurately quotes a doctor or reporter, although the broader source and authenticity boundary is retained.

judgeRationale.readability: The article follows the video's persuasion sequence and consistently separates visible facts, author claims, inferences, and unknowns.
judgeRationale.knowledgePrioritization: Medical causality, diagnostic framing, privacy, commercial disclosure, carrier conflicts, and use boundaries receive priority over decorative detail.
judgeRationale.evidenceUsefulness: Exact text, bounded timestamps, targeted frames, OCR rows, UI states, and the hashed audio ledger make material findings auditable.
judgeRationale.executionValue: A reader can distinguish what the demo establishes from what still requires clinical, privacy, commercial, or access verification before relying on it.
judgeRationale.compressionWithoutLoss: The reconstruction preserves unusually strong boundary detail, but repeats several medical/privacy caveats and the final inventory, making it longer than necessary for a fast decision read.

metaAudit.rationale: Independent checks found no available carrier, material meaning change, or audited relation outside the current protocol/evaluation topology. The source video's complete audio stream was independently re-decoded to the same PCM SHA-256 recorded in SRC-AUDIO-NON-SPEECH. Its 22 timeline windows cover 0-105.629 seconds with zero gaps, all nine specified narrative-transition windows are present, and the candidate preserves classifier and source-separation limits rather than treating labels as literal truth. All 17 coverage-matrix relationships use resolvable first-order cue/shot/frame/OCR/source references with no KU-* evidence refs, and canonical localization checks confirm the three previously vulnerable knowledge units now keep direct evidence within their time ranges.

examples.item: All independent hard gates pass and JUDGE was completed. This evaluation result is not a downstream-readiness announcement.
